prompt:
CONCEPT: a female personification of Fei Yi (비의), a court official of Shu Han in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms — the calm statesman who stitched together Wei Yan's and Yang Yi's quarrels. Reimagined as a woman; her costume, ornaments, colours and bearing carry her famous deeds and temperament. This is a character design, not a historical portrait.
STYLE: Premium Korean MMORPG promotional character render — an in-engine 3D character model with hand-painted textures, not flat cel shading and not a 2D anime illustration: semi-realistic volumetric forms, porcelain skin with a soft subsurface glow and glossy specular highlights, a small refined face with delicate realistic-anime features, long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure — soft, rounded volume at bust, hips and thighs in the body type SILHOUETTE names; never thin, flat or boyishly straight. Polished metal, silk and gems catch sharp highlights. Extremely intricate ornamented costume — filigree metalwork, jewel inlays, layered translucent fabrics and fine embroidery. Character-select-screen lighting: strong rim light, soft key light on the face, drifting light particles, atmospheric depth with a softly blurred background. Luxurious, high-detail finish.
TRAITS of Fei Yi to carry in her design and the scene: effortless competence, famous for playing go while handling affairs of state.
FACTION — Shu Han. Palette: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade.
AGE: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
SILHOUETTE: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist build; a hime cut — long straight hair with blunt cheek-length sidelocks with short baby bangs; ocean-blue hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a soft, gentle warmth; fair skin; oval face; moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes — long phoenix eyes with lifted outer corners, outer eye corners tilting sharply upward; thin straight brows; slim, delicate nose with a refined bridge; soft, full lips; magenta eyes; bold red lipstick.
WORLD — MEDIEVAL FANTASY: a righteous highland kingdom of Western medieval high fantasy: grey-stone castles and fortified abbeys on green mountain ridges, alpine meadows, waterfalls and oak forests, heraldic banners of green and gold bearing a dragon device, oaths sworn under an ancient oak, gentle green nature-magic. COSTUME (medieval fantasy): a royal chancellor's or court scholar's dress — a long embroidered coat with a stole, a seal ring, ledgers and a quill. Western medieval high-fantasy dress — plate, mail and heraldic tabards, gowns and mantles, circlets and crowns; steel, leather, wool, velvet and gold, subtle magical glow along the patterns. Her Three Kingdoms origin shows only through her signature item, her colours and her bearing — her outfit is Western: no wrap-collar robes, no wide hanfu sleeves, no flowing Chinese-style robe over armor, no East-Asian armor, no machinery, no modern material. The setting is Western European medieval — stone castles, Romanesque or Gothic architecture, European mountains, forests and towns; no Chinese architecture, no pagodas or curved tiled roofs, no hanzi on banners. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise. Celestial ornament: feather-and-gold wing-shaped ornaments at the shoulders or back, a translucent gauze overskirt, a jewelled circlet.
OUTFIT SILHOUETTE: a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the role costume above.
MOOD: serene celestial key art — pastel sky light, a soft halo of light behind her, floating golden light particles and drifting feathers.
EXPOSURE (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or gown showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
SIGNATURE ITEM: a lacquered jar of go stones — reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style and no Chinese fittings, silk tassels or hanzi. She holds or carries it, drawn at full scale. It is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
EXPRESSION: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no horse or other creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers — banners and shields carry only heraldic devices (a beast or a crest), never letters or Chinese characters.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.

observations: 바다빛 긴 히메 컷·밝은 피부, 옥색·금색·백색 흉갑 가운.
한 손에 흰 바둑알, 다른 손에 열린 금속 항아리와 흑백 돌. 전신·양 부츠와 항아리 외곽 확인.
서양 성채·산·폭포·녹색 용 문장. 항아리는 금색 장식이 두드러지고 룬 발광은 약함.
